name: project_pr
description: Create a PR following claude-wrapper conventions.
prompt:
Create a pull request for the following changes.

CONVENTIONS:
- Title: Use conventional commit format (e.g., 'feat: add xyz', 'fix: resolve bug')
- Link: Reference issues for auto-closing (Closes #123)
- Description: Include what changed and why
- NO merge: PR author does not merge (maintainer will review and merge)
- NO signatures: Remove any 'Generated with Claude Code' or Co-Authored-By lines

BRANCH INFO:
- Branch naming: fix/, feat/, docs/, refactor/, test/, chore/
- Branch should be based on main
- Branch should be pushed before creating PR

{details}

arguments.name: details
arguments.description: PR details: branch name, issue ref, what changed.
